name: Viscer Medical III
summary:
VisceR Medical III is an immersive VR clinical training experience designed to develop practical skills in patient communication, history taking, clinical assessment, decision-making, and patient management.

The pack includes interactive clinical scenarios across multiple areas of medicine:

PATIENT COMMUNICATION & CLINICAL SKILLS 
• Building Rapport 
• Delivering Bad News 
• End-of-Life Conversations

CARDIOLOGY & GENERAL MEDICINE 
• Arrhythmia Management 
• Ischemic Heart Disease 
• Hypertension Monitori
